no settle after the state write: 0/5/10/25/50/100/200/400 ms measured byte-identical on Morgan's XML state path

reasons: beats recipe: 0.859 against 1.933 mean objective distance over the 50 targets both arms scored
beats inversion: 0.859 against 1.339 mean objective distance over the 50 targets both arms scored

parameter MAE is 0.2636 and selector accuracy 0.6729; neither is part of this gate, because the plugin's controls are not identifiable from its output and a match that sounds right with different numbers is still a match
caveats: rendered by swift (plugin 1.0.3), which reports reproducible=False: identical-state observations from one reused instance differ, and per-band levels move by up to 5.228794 dB. Every number below carries that, and none of them may be committed without it

no --probe-di was given, so candidates were rendered through a synthetic decaying noise-burst sequence. It shows attack and decay clearly and shows sustained or palm-muted playing not at all — match against your own DI before trusting this on a real part.

each arm's final objective on each target is the mean of 3 renders of the selected vector, because this backend does not repeat itself. The per-target peak-to-peak spread and observation count are stored beside every outcome
